summary: Job template launch options: Privilege escalation (--become), Provisioning callback, Enable webhook for GitHub or GitLab (service, URL, key, PAT credential), Concurrent jobs, Enable fact storage and Prevent instance group fallback; the template must be saved before Launch template works.
